Subject: ancient baobab tree canopy seen directly overhead, widely spreading thick pale gray branching limbs with isolated rounded clusters of small matte olive leaves, huge organic open crown. Camera: strictly orthographic bird's eye looking vertically straight down at 90 degrees, same camera as overhead tabletop character tokens. Show the complete crown and branching network as seen from above. Art direction: finely illustrated painterly botanical map asset, detailed believable leaves and wood, crisp articulated organic silhouette, visible depth between leaf clusters, subtle hand painted texture. Natural desaturated foliage with restrained highlights from upper left, dark richly textured inner canopy, professional fantasy cartography quality. One SINGLE tree only, centered, occupies about 85% of a square canvas, generous clean margins. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including gaps between branches. Preserve fine twigs and leaf tips. No ground, grass patch, rock base, circular token frame, border, cast ground shadow, text, labels, watermark. No front view, side view, isometric angle, horizon, upright visible trunk below the crown. Each asset must have its own natural crown silhouette and branching composition.
